manifest.renderer: shipping createAudio, default stereo; no HRTF experiment
manifest.conditions: 12 weapons + 5 actions + 3 materials; 8 contexts per class; 160 trials/output; optional counterbalanced paired outputs
manifest.nuisanceFactors: fractional action weapon and step/landing variants; isolated fixed lab timing

limitations: Isolated repeated stimuli use fixed lab timing, not native weapon cadence.
Action weapons and step/landing variants are fractional nuisance factors.
No inference about network latency, gait synchrony, HRTF, elevation or hardware CPU.
